acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC1: Verified in the running app (dev server started via npm run start:keycloak plus node mock-server/server.js) and via the existing automated suite. The new vertical resizer in src/app/features/facility/components/containers/combined-structure/combined-structure.component.html (data-testid=combined-tree-height-resizer) carries role=separator, aria-orientation=horizontal (correct WAI-ARIA APG semantics for a horizontal splitter bar dividing vertically-stacked panels), tabindex=0, aria-label=Resize tree panel height, and dynamic aria-valuemin/valuenow/valuemax bound to combined-structure.component.ts treeHeightResizerAriaValues signal. Live browser check (Playwright, msedge) confirmed: the element receives focus, a visible focus outline is rendered (computed outline was auto 1px rgb(0,95,204); screenshot captured then deleted), Tab and Shift+Tab move focus in and out without trapping it, and ArrowUp/ArrowDown change aria-valuenow by the configured 24px step (onTreeHeightResizerKeyDown / getTreePanelResizeOffset). Proven by npx playwright test on combined-structure-tree-height-resize.e2e.spec.ts (test named resizes tree panel height via keyboard arrow keys on the separator, passing) and by the Vitest unit test of the same name in combined-structure.component.spec.ts.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC2: Verified live: dragging the handle (mousedown/mousemove/mouseup on the separator) resizes the electrical and mechanical cdm-dual-tree panels independently and in opposite directions, mirroring the pre-existing horizontal drag-resize pattern (onResizerMouseDown/startDrag/resizePanelsByOffset generalized with a y-axis branch). Proven by the e2e tests resizes tree panel height via vertical drag handle and drag handle updates electrical and mechanical tree heights independently in combined-structure-tree-height-resize.e2e.spec.ts, both passing against the running app (4 of 4 tests green via npx playwright test --project=msedge).
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC3: Verified: getMinHeight/getMinSize read the computed min-height per panel (--combined-tree-panel-min-height: 180px in combined-structure.component.scss, MIN_TREE_PANEL_HEIGHT=180 fallback in combined-structure.component.ts) and resizePanelsByOffset clamps the drag/keyboard offset so neither panel can shrink below it. Proven by the e2e test clamps tree panel height at configured minimum during drag (asserts panel height stays within min-height and min-height+1 after extreme drags in both directions), passing against the running app.
